يعتزمان (form VIII)
# يَعْتَزِمَانِ (yaʕtazimāni) /jaʕ.ta.zi.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# يُعْتَزَمَانِ (yuʕtazamāni) /juʕ.ta.za.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
